{When White plays an early Bd3, Black can win a tempo for the famous
"Capablanca's Freeing Manuever." What should Black play to trade pieces and
reach a safe position?} 8... dxc4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find
it.] [%hint Trade and attack the d3 bishop.]} (8... h6 $5 {This is a fine move,
but not the traditional weapon preferred by World Champion Capablanca. What
was his favorite move here?}) (8... b6 $5 {This is a fine move, but not the
traditional weapon preferred by World Champion Capablanca. What was his
favorite move here?}) (8... a6 $5 {This is a fine move, but not the
traditional weapon preferred by World Champion Capablanca. What was his
favorite move here?}) 9. Bxc4 {Good start! Black's only serious problem is the
cramped position. How can you force at least one trade to ease the cramping?}
Nd5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Force White to
trade the dark-squared bishop.]} (9... h6 $5 {This is a fine move, but not the
traditional weapon preferred by World Champion Capablanca. What was his
favorite move here to force trades?}) (9... b5 $5 {This is a fine move, but
not the traditional weapon preferred by World Champion Capablanca. What was
his favorite move here to force trades?}) (9... b6 $5 {This is a fine move,
but not the traditional weapon preferred by World Champion Capablanca. What
was his favorite move here to force trades?}) (9... a6 $5 {This is a fine move,
but not the traditional weapon preferred by World Champion Capablanca. What
was his favorite move here to force trades?}) (9... Nh5 $2 10. Bxe7 {This
forces a trade, but the knight on h5 is poorly placed. Find another way to
execute the same idea.}) (9... Ng4 $2 10. Bf4 {White is better. Try again.})
10. Bxe7 {Great job! What capture should you play next?} Qxe7 {[%wrong White
wins material. Try again.] [%hint Recapture and develop a piece] Well played!
Black has a solid position.} (10... Nxe7 $2 11. O-O {Black will have a
difficult time in this cramped position. Try to find a better move.}) (10...
Nxc3 $2 11. Bxd8 {White meets Nxd1 with Be7 and an advantage. Try again.}) *
